selection.name: Bash of the Deep
selection.description: The hero will bash every 4 melee attacks or 4 ranged attacks, dealing bonus physical damage and stunning for a duration. Deals double damage against creeps.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Deals an extra 150 damage and instantly kills creeps on bash.

selection.name: Battery Assault
selection.description: The hero discharges high-powered shrapnel at random nearby enemy units, dealing minor magical damage and ministun. Deals double damage to creeps.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: +275 radius and hits all targets within radius.

selection.name: Bloodlust
selection.description: Incites a frenzy in a friendly unit, increasing its movement speed and attack speed. Gives bonus attacks speed if cast on Ogre himself. Can be cast on towers.
selection.differences: AI: Prioritize cast on the closest ally.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: +25 attack speed, casting Bloodlust on an ally also buffs themselves.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Bloodlust now buffs the entire team.

selection.name: Bloodrage
selection.description: Drives Bloodseeker into a bloodthirsty rage which causes him to attack faster and deal more spell damage at the cost of a percentage of his health per second. Provides half attack speed to allied heroes.
selection.differences: Hero always casts Bloodrage on themselves.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: When cast, also gives the closest ally hero within 800 units Bloodrage. +25 attack speed and +8% spell amplification.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Attacks from heroes with Bloodrage now also deal 1.8% of the target's maximum health as pure damage and heals for the same amount.

selection.name: Brain Sap
selection.description: The caster feasts on the vital energies of an enemy unit, healing the caster and dealing damage.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Brain Sap adds extra maximum health to the caster for the duration of the round based on the amount sapped. Heal/Damage increased by +150, and applies a maximum level Enfeeble on the target.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Brain Sap is also cast on enemies within 550 radius of the primary target.
